items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He came up here with Dollie and went into one of the rehearsal halls... when the President was finally introduced

ctx.x: I noticed on one of your – one of the programs that you’ve done here at the Artists Collective, that the jazz ensemble opened a program with one of Sonny Stitt’s tunes. It was in the package that Dollie gave us yesterday.
Yeah, that’s true, when Clinton was here. The thing that’s so interesting about .
